caption: A pager on vibrate goes off on a nightstand and rattles against the wood.

sa.check: A pager lies on a wooden nightstand.
The pager goes off: its screen lights or it begins to shiver.
It rattles against the wood: it shivers and hops in place.
It lies still first and the rattling begins during the clip.

pc.expect: The pager moves only while it visibly shivers and is still otherwise.
pc.fail: The pager slides while lying perfectly still; or keeps moving after the shiver has stopped; or moves in one smooth glide with no shiver.

pc.expect: Other small loose objects on the nightstand tremble in the same bursts as the pager.
pc.fail: A coin, pen or pair of glasses beside it lies dead still while the pager rattles hard; or the other object rattles while the pager is still; or the two rattle at different moments.
pc.precondition: Other small loose objects lie on the nightstand.

pc.expect: The pager stays flat on the nightstand; at the edge it would fall.
pc.fail: The pager hovers; or stands up on end; or rises.

pc.expect: The wood and the pager stay rigid.
pc.fail: The wood ripples; or the pager bends; or the pager leaves a groove in the wood.

pc.expect: One pager; it does not pass into the wood, duplicate or vanish.
pc.fail: A second pager appears; or it vanishes; or sinks into the wood; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: The pager's colour, its screen and the lamp beside it stay the same.
pc.fail: The pager changes colour; or its screen shows different content at random; or the lamp beside it changes.
